note_suffix: CONSISTENCY FIX 2026-09-03 (term '大神殿最深部'): KNOWN CASE, investigated per owner's specific instruction (do not default to majority-wins blindly). This entry's own note claims deliberate reasoning: "matches 'the Grand Temple of Mu' naming used throughout the dungeon-label entries below." Verified this claim against the actual dungeon-label family and found it does NOT hold up: (1) entries whose JP explicitly writes ムー大神殿 (with Mu) consistently render 'the Grand Temple of Mu' (0x52f670, 0x4e92d0, 0x4e9e70, 0x4ec660, 0x538a60 'Grand Temple of Mu Entrance', 0x538d70 'Grand Temple of Mu Exit'); (2) entries whose JP is the bare/elliptical form WITHOUT ムー (大神殿入口, 大神殿内部, 大神殿最深部 - 15 entries total across all three) consistently drop BOTH 'Grand' and 'Mu', rendering just 'the Temple Entrance' / 'the Temple Interior' / 'the/To the Temple Depths'. This entry's own JP (大神殿最深部マス, no ムー) is the bare form. The exact sibling pattern - a マス-suffixed panel-label built on the bare form - already exists at 0x538fd0 (大神殿入口マス -> 'Temple Entrance Panel', NOT 'Grand Temple of Mu Entrance Panel'), which directly confirms the マス-panel-label form should also drop 'Grand'/'Mu'. Conclusion: the note's stated justification rests on a mistaken premise about what 'the dungeon-label entries below' actually do, so the EXCEPTION clause (preserve documented deliberate choices) does not apply here - the note documents a REASON, not a verified-correct one, and checking it was exactly what was asked. Realigned to 'Temple Depths Panel', matching both the 5-entry 大神殿最深部 majority and the 0x538fd0 sibling precedent.

note_suffix: CONSISTENCY FIX 2026-09-03 (term '熟練度'): 熟練度 is a formally-defined, named job stat (5 ranks, raises salary, persists across job changes - see the help-manual page 0x4eb040, which uses highlight markup and the capitalized 'Proficiency' 5 times while formally introducing the mechanic) and appears the same way in the battle-system level-up message (0x457db0: "'s proficiency rose to..."). 4 of 6 occurrences, all in casual/dialect NPC advice dialogue, paraphrased the same mechanic as 'skill'/'skill level(s)' instead (0x4859f0 Osaka-dialect, 0x485ef0 アル-dialect, 0x4862f0, 0x487290). No note documents this as deliberate - it reads as a synonym drift in casual paraphrase rather than a reasoned split (unlike e.g. the documented 死神 Doom/Reaper split elsewhere in the audit). Realigned the 4 casual lines to 'Proficiency' so the same underlying stat reads as the same name in dialogue, the help page, and battle messages, while keeping each line's dialect flavor intact.

old_en: It seems a Thief can change into higher-tier jobs by raising skill in another job alongside it~. But for a lot of jobs, raising skill alone isn't enough to change - you'll need to find someone willing to change you~.
new_en: It seems a Thief can change into higher-tier jobs by raising Proficiency in another job alongside it~. But for a lot of jobs, raising Proficiency alone isn't enough to change - you'll need to find someone willing to change you~.
